unit: U2 cutout puppetry (camera unit A: Sh1, Sh2a, Sh2b, Sh5 heap)
build_scripts: films/swarm/le-chant-du-styrene/cutout-build/ (cut.py GrabCut, layout.py constraint graph + cameras, geo.py geometry.json, gel.py gel ramp, render.py frames, heap.py Sh5 heap, finish.py stills/stats)
geometry_note: Canonical layout for the Sh2b->Sh3a shape match is cameras.sh2b_hold (zoom 0.75, centre (9,26) world): rings[k].film.sh2b_hold.home_centre / outer_R / inner_r, arm_polyline, gate, plus hub_film and sprue. It is the bare (left) runner of the photograph with the four loose rings homed by the gate-contact constraint. U3's test shot measured the right-hand runner-with-rings (test-shot/geometry.json); its cavity layout must be re-generated from this file (or reconciled) for the 15.8-17.6 s hold to match the mould outline.

sh1.content: four loose rings held on black, slow camera drift (zoom 1.00->1.025), one ring settles after being set down at 0.6 s, blue practicals at 0.3x

sh2a.content: wide (zoom 0.62): bare runner right, rings left; rings fly on eased quadratic arcs, posed on twos, staggered starts 10.30/11.10/11.80/12.50 s, rotation <= 9 deg, lift scale +10%, always in front of the runner (pass over its arms)
sh2a.ring1_home: ring 1 (left arm) is exactly home on frame 312 (t=13.000 s, offset 0.0 px; 0.07 px on f311); it is the last frame of Sh2a; cut C1 at 13.02 s falls between frames 312 and 313

sh2b.content: close (zoom 1.12 centred on the right arm pair) gliding (smoothstep) to the complete-shot framing by 15.80 s, then hold to 17.60; rings 2-4 home at 14.00/14.70/15.30 s; every ring settles with a spring-damper (zeta 0.35, 3.2 Hz, peak 3.84 deg, outward recoil 2.5 px from the gate, never penetrating); residual at 15.80 s <= 0.003 deg

sh5.content: real heap of orange plastic granules GrabCut onto black, lit warm from above with the base falling to black; ragged real top edge across the band (band y ~60-120 on the right), cropped by the band sides and bottom; U4's falling pellets land on its top edge. Hold is static (motion stops by 36.5 is up to U4's layer)

delivery_format: 960x408 picture band only, no captions, no letterbox, no grain (the editor applies the one shared grain); PNG sequences + lossless libx264rgb crf 0 mp4 at 24 fps
failure_mask_legend: red = hue said plastic but GrabCut rejected it; yellow = GrabCut kept an unsaturated (table/steel) pixel

grabcut_checks.fg_components_per_piece: 1 for every piece (no stray foreground islands)
grabcut_checks.note: the remaining enclosed background regions are the real bores of the rings (89-241 px in the loose rings) and, in runner_with_rings, the bores plus the gaps between arm and ring; pinholes <= 40 px (JPEG noise) were filled. Gate stubs, legs and the sprue post are kept on the bare runner (one component). Islands dropped from the bare-runner rectangle: parts of the loose rings intruding into it.

heap.note: heap + loose grains within 30 px kept; granules seen through the perforated plate and the floor reflection rejected (red in failure mask)

transforms.rest_layout: loose rings keep the photograph's own relative layout, translated by (-482,-270) world px
transforms.contact: ring centre = gate (arm tip) + (ellipse support radius along -u - 2 px fused overlap) * u
transforms.arm_assignment: ring 1 -> left arm (181 deg), ring 2 -> up-right (297), ring 3 -> right (9), ring 4 -> down (105); sprue = the short post at 250 deg

gel_ramp.reason: no red or amber translucent runner photograph under an allowed licence was found (proposals round 2 search; process_verse.json not present when this unit ran, so no replacement was reported)
gel_ramp.method: Beer-Lambert re-lighting of the photograph's own V channel: optical thickness th = wall*(0.08 + 2.9*(-ln V/V98) + 0.45*dt/dtmax); transmission exp(-alpha*th), alpha=(0.20,1.45,3.6) RGB, warm backlight (1.0,0.86,0.66); real specular catches kept warm; grazing edges darkened within 3 px (no glow outline); in-material scatter blur 3.5 px x0.28. Declared wall factor: runner 0.42 (thin arms, amber-orange), rings 1.3 (thick discs, deep red). Teal hue discarded; shape, shading, gate stubs and moulding marks are the photograph's.
gel_ramp.unify: one mild halation of the amber cores (blur 5 & 16 px) and a shared highlight roll-off (knee lum 0.66, no whites, max lum 207), identical in all four shots

layers: 0 blue practicals (handmade gaussian disc r~54 px at (128,78) and bar at y 34, x 540-860), parallax 0.3x of camera motion
2 rings 1.0x, always above the runner (occlusion DAG: rings > runner > practicals)

measurements.gate_contact_residual_px: 0 by construction (centre-to-gate distance equals measured support radius)
measurements.band_height_fill_sh2b_hold: ring 2 top ~y 14 to ring 4 bottom ~y 398 of 408 (94%)

Heap candidates rejected after looking: r2/pellets.jpg (granules inside a sack, no free-standing heap), r2/nurdles.jpg (scattered beach nurdles in grass, no heap), kf/pellet_azul.jpg (Pellet azul.jpg, ISIPLAST, CC BY-SA 4.0: frame-filling flat field of blue granules, no silhouette); 'Granulat Lasertransparent.jpg' (Laserlicht, CC0) is grey studio granules on white, too cold; Commons searches 'Kunststoffgranulat', 'plastic granules', 'polystyrene granules', 'plastic pellets pile', 'Granulat Haufen', 'resin pellets' run 2026-11-16.
Moving Image Archive cache: not used by this unit (plan.md: no plastics footage in the cache; these shots are puppetry of stills).
gaps: Amber share is lower than the reference: lit pixels in H 28-50 are 7-8% vs 32% in the reference band; the plastic reads red and orange, runner orange, rings deep red. The reference's bright yellow trees belong to Sh4 (U4).
Frames are darker overall than the reference band (lum<20: 0.89 vs 0.54) because a single runner occupies the band; the plan's acceptance (>=65% <20, p99<=210) is met.
Ring ellipse major-axis direction for the contact support is approximate (rings are near-circular, minor/major ~0.94; error < 3 px).
Sh2b hold: ring 4's bottom rim comes within ~10 px of the band's bottom edge; ring 2 within ~14 px of the top.

No sound produced by this unit (U1 owns stems); ring-home frames for clicks: ring 1 f312 (13.000 s), ring 2 f336 (14.00), ring 3 f353 (14.70), ring 4 f368 (15.30 s; f367 is 15.29); set-down settle in Sh1 at 0.60 s.
